'''Raider 3''' is a [[United States Marine Corps]] call sign appearing in the [[Fallout TV series season 2|second season]] of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Demon in the Snow]]===
During the [[Sino-American War]], [[Cooper Howard]] and [[Charlie Whiteknife]] are searching for their lost comrade Raider 3 on an island somewhere on the Alaskan front.
